one_line: Anglo-Indian poet and Hindu College teacher who led the radical Young Bengal debating circle in 1820s Calcutta.

appearance.age_look: Early twenties, slight but energetic build, upright posture suggesting intellectual intensity rather than physical strength.
appearance.face: Oval face with a fair Anglo-Indian complexion, straight nose, sharp jawline, subtly arched brows, large thoughtful eyes, and a default expression of earnest, debating focus with a hint of youthful idealism.
appearance.hair: Soft wavy dark brown hair, neatly brushed back from the forehead and reaching just above the shirt collar, with short sideburns; no headwear, keeping a clean early-19th-century Anglo-Indian college teacher look.
appearance.costume: A high-collared white linen shirt with slightly puffed sleeves, worn under a fitted waist-length dark navy wool tailcoat with narrow lapels; a simple black cravat tied at the neck; straight-cut light beige cotton trousers reaching the ankles, and black leather shoes with a subtle square toe; the overall look is that of a young Calcutta-based Anglo-Indian intellectual in the late 1820s, blending British-influenced college attire with local practicality in light fabrics appropriate to the climate.
appearance.signature: A worn leather-bound poetry notebook held in his left hand, with a single loose folded pamphlet of debate notes tucked under it, and a quill pen between the fingers of his right hand as if mid-argument.

ref_desc: Henry Louis Vivian Derozio is a fair-complexioned young Anglo-Indian man with wavy dark brown hair brushed back, wearing a white high-collared shirt, dark navy tailcoat, light beige trousers and black shoes, holding a leather-bound poetry notebook with quill and pamphlet accents.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Henry Louis Vivian Derozio: an early-twenties, slight but energetic Anglo-Indian man with an oval fair complexion, sharp jawline, and large thoughtful eyes in an earnest debating expression. His wavy dark brown hair is brushed back from his forehead, neatly trimmed above the shirt collar with short sideburns, and he wears no headwear. Dress him in a historically accurate late-1820s Calcutta college outfit: a crisp white linen high-collared shirt with slightly puffed sleeves, covered by a fitted waist-length dark navy wool tailcoat with narrow lapels; a simple black cravat at his neck; straight-cut light beige cotton trousers to the ankles, and plain black leather shoes with a subtle square toe. In his left hand he carries a worn leather-bound poetry notebook with a single folded pamphlet of debate notes tucked beneath it, while his right hand lightly holds a quill pen as if making a point. Use a restrained palette of dark navy, white, light beige, black, and dark brown, and show him from multiple angles to clearly present face, hair, clothing details, and the notebook-quill signature prop.
